summary: Require an explicit edge-capable Vite composition for the developer Devnet preview launcher.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only launcher requirement. Public loopback-only gateway admission is unchanged; preview deployments explicitly select their edge-capable composition with WF_VITE_CONFIG.

downtime.detail: No deployment changes in this PR.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners supply WF_VITE_CONFIG when adopting the developer preview launcher.
